def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    # line color = color of full rows/cols
    line_rows=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(I[i]))==1]
    line_cols=[j for j in range(W) if all(I[i][j]==I[0][0] for i in range(H))]
    lc=I[line_rows[0]][0]
    lr=set(line_rows); lcc=set(line_cols)
    def is_marker(i,j): return I[i][j] not in (lc,1) and i in lr and j in lcc
    mr=sorted(i for i in lr if any(is_marker(i,j) for j in lcc))
    mc=sorted(j for j in lcc if any(is_marker(i,j) for i in lr))
    spacing=mr[1]-mr[0]
    O=[]
    for i in range(len(mr)):
        row=[]
        for a in range(len(mc)-1):
            p,q=mc[a],mc[a+1]
            v=None
            if is_marker(mr[i],p) and is_marker(mr[i],q) and I[mr[i]][p]==I[mr[i]][q]:
                c=I[mr[i]][p]
                above = (mr[i]-spacing>=0) and is_marker(mr[i]-spacing,p) and is_marker(mr[i]-spacing,q) and I[mr[i]-spacing][p]==c and I[mr[i]-spacing][q]==c
                if above: v=c
            row.append(v if v is not None else 1)
        O.append(row)
    return O
